definitions.name: Nathair's Mischief
definitions.summary: A 20-ft cube of fey-and-dragon mischief: roll a d4 when cast and at the start of each of your turns (charmed, blinded, giggling and incapacitated, or difficult terrain until your next turn; saves as the effect says). You can move the cube 10 ft before each roll.
definitions.material: a piece of crust from an apple pie

definitions.name: Rime's Binding Ice
definitions.summary: A 30-ft cone of cold: Constitution save; on a failure cold damage and the creature's speed is 0 for 1 minute (until it or someone next to it uses an action to break the ice); half damage and no ice on a success.

definitions.name: Ashardalon's Stride
definitions.summary: Flames from your feet: +20 ft speed (+5 per slot level above 3rd) and moving doesn't provoke opportunity attacks. A creature or object you move within 5 ft of takes fire damage, once per turn.

definitions.name: Raulothim's Psychic Lance
definitions.summary: A lance of psychic power at a creature you see, or one you name within range: Intelligence save; on a failure psychic damage and incapacitated until the start of your next turn; half and not incapacitated on a success.

definitions.name: Summon Draconic Spirit
definitions.summary: A draconic spirit (chromatic, gem or metallic) appears and fights beside you; it grows with the slot level. You share one of its damage resistances while the spell lasts.
definitions.material: an object with the image of a dragon engraved on it, worth at least 500 gp

definitions.name: Fizban's Platinum Shield
definitions.summary: A field of silvery light around a creature (you can choose yourself): half cover, resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning and poison, and evasion against Dexterity saves. A bonus action on later turns moves it to another creature within 60 ft of the field.
definitions.material: a platinum-plated dragon scale, worth at least 500 gp

definitions.name: Draconic Transformation
definitions.summary: You take on draconic features: blindsight 30 ft, incorporeal wings with a 60-ft flying speed, and a 60-ft cone breath of force (Dexterity save, half on a success) when cast and as a bonus action on later turns.
definitions.material: a statuette of a dragon, worth at least 500 gp

definitions.name: Ashardalon's Stride
definitions.summary: +20 ft speed (+5 per slot level above 3rd); moving doesn't provoke opportunity attacks; creatures and objects you pass within 5 ft take fire damage once per turn.
reminders: Your movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks.
Moving within 5 ft of a creature or loose object: it takes the spell's fire damage (once per turn each).

definitions.name: Fizban's Platinum Shield
definitions.summary: Half cover (+2 AC and Dexterity saves), resistance to acid, cold, fire, lightning and poison, and evasion.
reminders: Evasion: a Dexterity save for half damage does nothing on a success, half on a failure.
The caster can move it to another creature within 60 ft of the field as a bonus action.

definitions.name: Draconic Transformation
definitions.summary: Blindsight 30 ft, a 60-ft flying speed, and a force breath (60-ft cone, Dexterity save) as a bonus action on each later turn.

actions.name: Draconic breath

roll.label: force damage (60-ft cone, Dexterity save against your spell save DC, half on a success)

actions.note: 60-ft cone of force: Dexterity save against your spell save DC, half on a success.

reminders: Blindsight 30 ft: you see invisible creatures within it unless they hide from you.

definitions.name: Shared Resistances
definitions.summary: Resistance to one damage type your draconic spirit resists, chosen when you summon it, while the spell lasts.
reminders: Chromatic and metallic spirits resist acid, cold, fire, lightning and poison; gem spirits resist force, necrotic, psychic, radiant and thunder.

definitions.name: Gift of the Chromatic Dragon
definitions.summary: Chromatic Infusion: once per long rest, a bonus action makes a weapon deal +1d4 acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison for 1 minute. Reactive Resistance: when you take one of those damage types, your reaction gives resistance to it (proficiency bonus times per long rest).

actions.name: Chromatic Infusion
actions.note: Touch a simple or martial weapon: +1d4 of the chosen type on its hits for 1 minute.

actions.name: Reactive Resistance
actions.note: When you take acid, cold, fire, lightning or poison damage: resistance to that instance.

definitions.summary: +1 to Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma. Telekinetic Reprisal: when a creature within 10 ft damages you, your reaction forces a Strength save (DC 8 + proficiency + that ability's modifier): 2d8 force and pushed 10 ft, or half and not pushed (proficiency bonus times per long rest).

actions.name: Telekinetic Reprisal

roll.label: force damage (Strength save; pushed 10 ft on a failure, half and not pushed on a success)

actions.note: When a creature within 10 ft of you damages you: it makes a Strength save.

definitions.summary: Draconic Healing: you learn Cure Wounds, free once per long rest (or with your slots), cast with Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma. actions.name: Protective Wings
